purpose: Observed caught-mass fractions for the five focal juvenile/adult stocks and shark/skate pools before choosing a model proxy
queries: ICES 2019 North Sea cod catch at age landings discards age0 1 2 haddock whiting saithe herring WGNSSK
ICES2019 herring North Sea catch at age0 1 HAWG

sources.read: Stock identity and annual landings/discards table
sources.finding: Cod stock includes Subarea4, Division7.d, Subdivision20. Annual totals do not identify mass at the exact 24-month stanza threshold and do not isolate LME022.

sources.read: Search index; full open timed out
sources.finding: North Sea herring stock extends through3.a and7.d. No matched LME-specific caught-mass fraction read.

sources.read: Search index identifies catch-at-age numbers; full PDF fetch failed
sources.finding: Numbers require weight-at-age and fishery/area aggregation before mass shares. No fraction inferred from numbers or legal size.

sources.read: Methods and materials, stock/fleet and age-assessment setup
sources.finding: Confirms age-structured WGNSSK/STECF input availability but provides no directly applicable LME022 catch-mass split at all five Rpath stage boundaries.

decision: No compatible measured 2019 LME caught-mass split was recovered in this bounded search. Use exact model1991 landings+discards proportions for independently identified candidates, W4 Medium; this is a historical composition/catchability transfer, not observed 2019 proportions. No claim that underlying ICES age data do not exist.

other_stage_definitions.JuvenileSharks: predecessor <40cm; length type not specified in passage

cutoff_warning: Predecessor printed annual age/length labels and focal Rpath month transitions are not interchangeable. Proxy uses focal group catches without constructing a new age/length conversion.
